subject: CS481
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 3 Arabic videos. The English coverage is complete, utilizing a view count exception for one topic. Arabic coverage has two gaps: 'Intellectual Property Rights and Locke's Theory' had no relevant candidates, and 'Open-Source Software and Creative Commons Licenses' had no candidates that could pass the hard gates for both relevance and view count.

coverage.topic: Intellectual Property Rights and Locke's Theory
Intellectual Property Rights and Locke's Theory
coverage.note: No candidates specifically discuss Locke's theory. One candidate was a general IP lecture that was too long (>3600s), another was irrelevant.
More specific videos failed the view count or duration gates; this is the best eligible general introduction.

coverage.topic: Open-Source Software and Creative Commons Licenses
coverage.note: No candidate covering both OSS and CC licenses passed the 3000-view gate; selected the most relevant video with the highest view count (>500) under the exception rule.

coverage.topic: Open-Source Software and Creative Commons Licenses
coverage.note: All candidates failed a hard gate. High-view videos were not relevant enough (covered only OSS or CC, not both), and highly relevant videos failed the view count gate.

videos.title: Theories of IPR - YG Law
videos.topic_en: Intellectual Property Rights and Locke's Theory
videos.filter_reason: This concise animated video directly explains several IPR theories, including Locke's labor theory, making it highly relevant and accessible for students.

videos.title: Lecture 7: The Debate Over Software Patents
videos.topic_ar: حماية البرمجيات: حقوق النشر مقابل براءات الاختراع
videos.filter_reason: This video focuses specifically on the debate over software patents, directly addressing the core conceptual difficulty of distinguishing patentable processes from copyrightable expression in code.

videos.title: Copyright, Exceptions, and Fair Use: Crash Course Intellectual Property #3
videos.filter_reason: From CrashCourse, this video has massive reach and expertly explains the nuances and subjective nature of the fair use doctrine, which is the key challenge of this topic.

videos.title: DRM explained - How Netflix prevents you from downloading videos?
videos.filter_reason: With exceptional view count and clarity, this video provides a deep technical explanation of DRM using the relatable example of Netflix, which is crucial for understanding the associated ethical debates.

videos.title: How to choose a license for open scientific data and code?
videos.topic_en: Open-Source Software and Creative Commons Licenses
videos.topic_ar: البرمجيات مفتوحة المصدر وتراخيص المشاع الإبداعي
videos.filter_reason: This is the most relevant video found, as it explicitly explains and contrasts licenses for both data (Creative Commons) and code (Open Source), which is the core of the topic.

videos.title: شرح مبسط لمبادئ حقوق الملكية الفكرية.
videos.topic_ar: حماية البرمجيات: حقوق النشر مقابل براءات الاختراع
videos.filter_reason: This is a clear, well-viewed introduction to the principles and types of intellectual property, making it the best available option that passes all hard gates for this topic.

videos.title: كيف تستخدم الفيدوهات التى عليها حقوق طبع ونشر دون اذن صاحبها بشكل قانونى - شرح مبدأ الاستخدام العادل
videos.filter_reason: This video provides a strong, general explanation of the fair use principle with high viewership, making it more suitable for a university course than other candidates focused only on YouTube.

videos.title: لا تشتري العاب من اي متجر قبل لا تشوف هالمقطع - شرح نظام DRM
videos.filter_reason: This video explains the DRM system and its negative impacts on users, perfectly covering both the technical and ethical dimensions of the topic within the context of gaming.
